zh: 本篇测试稿有已确认的事实错误：文中说证据里没有当时的外部独立核查，这不准确。斯诺书中还记载了登记总署后来让各区登记员收集的供水资料，并称结果与他较早的调查一致（这不等于每个数字都经过独立审计）。文中部分统计数字也在复核。修订稿尚未通过审核，本篇不作为推荐阅读，请暂勿引用其数字或结论。
en: This TEST article contains a confirmed factual error: it says its evidence held no contemporary outside check, which is inaccurate. Snow's book also describes water-supply returns the Registrar General later asked district registrars to make, and reports that they agreed with his earlier inquiry (this is not an independent audit of every figure). Some of the article's figures are also being rechecked. A revised version has not passed review; this story is not recommended reading, and please do not rely on its figures or conclusions for now.
